Momentum is already rolling over: price is down 12–15% over the last 5 minutes, and GeckoTerminal's 5-minute volume (~$7.7k) is far below the 15-minute pace (~$148k), suggesting the first wave is spent. One has $421k in hourly volume, and one shows $401k liquidity that looks fake.

narrative.description: The name is a meme that riffs on crypto-Twitter KOLs (key opinion leaders, i.e. paid influencers) plus a cat mascot. Many copies appearing at once suggests a single trigger, maybe a tweet, image or KOL post, that set off a race among deployers. Nothing in the packet says what that trigger was.
narrative.why_spreading: The swarm of same-name launches within minutes points to a short-lived external trigger, most likely a social post, and snipers/bots rushing to copy it rather than a lasting community story. Nearly 1,000 unique buyers is real activity, but on Solana this pattern usually reflects bots and trenchers rotating between copies.
